blocks.title: Electrochemistry
blocks.text: The branch of chemistry which deals with inter conversion of electrical and chemical energy i.e., electrical energy into chemical energy and chemical energy into electrical energy is called electrochemistry.

blocks.title: Oxidation
blocks.text: Oxidation is a process involving loss of electron or electrons.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The book prints Zn⁰ → Zn⁺² + e⁻. A zinc atom loses two electrons to become Zn⁺², so the half-equation is Zn⁰ → Zn⁺² + 2e⁻ (only then do the charges balance).
Here Fe⁺² and Zn⁰ have lost electrons, therefore they are oxidized.

blocks.title: Reduction
blocks.text: Reduction is a process involving gain of electron or electrons.
In these examples, Cl⁰ and Cu⁺² have gained electrons; therefore, they are reduced.

blocks.title: Redox reactions
blocks.text: Oxidation and reduction always take place together. The reactions in which this happens is called redox reactions.

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Photosynthesis is a redox reaction which provides food for the entire planet, and another one is respiration that keeps you alive, both are redox reactions.
